name: frappe-errors-serverscripts
description: Use when debugging or preventing errors in Frappe Server Scripts. Prevents ImportError (the #1 error), NameError for restricted builtins, sandbox violations, doc_events not firing, wrong script type selection, SQL injection, permission denied in scheduled scripts, infinite loops, and API scripts not returning JSON. Covers error message mapping table. Keywords: server script error, ImportError, NameError, sandbox,, ImportError in server script, script not running, sandbox error, restricted function. restricted, frappe.throw, doc_events, scheduler, API script, SQL injection.
